dialogue.content: こんにちは
dialogue.English: Hello.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Hello, it's nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: お時間になったらスタートしますね。
dialogue.English: We'll get started when it's time.

dialogue.content: 承知いたしました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Pleased to meet you.

dialogue.content: なんとお呼びすればよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: How would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: 相談者で
dialogue.English: You can call me 'Client'.

dialogue.content: なんとお呼びすればよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: How would you like me to address you?

dialogue.content: 相談者さんで、いいのですが…じゃAさんでよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: 'Client' is fine, but... well, please call me A.

dialogue.content: Aさんよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you, A.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: You too.

dialogue.content: 今日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, what would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: きょうだいの関係で困っています
dialogue.English: I'm having some trouble with my siblings.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: ご兄弟でどのような状況なのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Could you tell me about the situation with your siblings?

dialogue.content: 姉と兄と妹と緊急の電話連絡をしたのですが、会話にならず切られてしまって困っています
dialogue.English: I tried to make an urgent phone call to my older sister, older brother, and younger sister, but it doesn't turn into a conversation. They just hang up on me, and I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: それは困りますよね
dialogue.English: That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのようなときに切られてしまうのでしょう
dialogue.English: Could you tell me in what situations they hang up on you?

dialogue.content: こちらとしては、伝えた事に関して、どうするつもりなのか、どう考えているのか今後の対応を決めたいのですが、「あーそうなんだ。分かった分かった」と、言って切られます
dialogue.English: I'm trying to decide on our next steps, so I want to know what they intend to do or what they think about what I've told them, but they just say, "Oh, I see. Got it, got it," and hang up.

dialogue.content: 繋がってますか？
dialogue.English: Are you still there?

dialogue.content: ご兄弟はお姉さん、お兄さん、そして妹さんということですが、今は4人の方々はそれぞれ離れて暮らしていらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: So you have an older sister, an older brother, and a younger sister. Am I correct in understanding that the four of you all live separately now?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 大切なお話しができなくなるのはこまりますよね
dialogue.English: It must be distressing not to be able to have these important conversations.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: ふだんはご兄弟の関係はいかがですか？
dialogue.English: How is your relationship with your siblings usually?

dialogue.content: 別居してから何の繋がりもありません
dialogue.English: We haven't had any contact since we started living apart.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もう少し詳しくお話しをうかがってもよろしいですか
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I asked for a few more details?

dialogue.content: Aさんはご兄弟の中で今までどのような存在だったのか伺ってもよろしいですか
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what kind of role you've played among your siblings up until now?

dialogue.content: 他の3人が繋がりあるかどうかは分かりませんが、話しが進まない事には私1人間に入って調整する事に疲れました
dialogue.English: I don't know if the other three are in contact with each other, but I'm tired of being the only one trying to mediate and move things forward when the conversation stalls.

dialogue.content: それはもどかしいしお辛くなりますね
dialogue.English: That must be frustrating and painful.

dialogue.content: 私の存在が他のきょうだいからみてですか？難しいですが、同居の時から皆、仲良くは無かったかもしれませんね
dialogue.English: You mean my role from my siblings' perspective? That's difficult, but I guess we weren't really close, even when we lived together.

dialogue.content: そんな中でもAさんは問題を解決したくて一生懸命に努力していらっしゃるのですね。
dialogue.English: And yet, despite that, you're trying so hard to resolve the issue.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その問題ですが、どのようなことなのか、もし宜しければ教えていただけますでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Regarding the issue, if you’re comfortable, could you tell me what it is?

dialogue.content: はい、母が余命宣告をされて後半年なんです
dialogue.English: Yes, my mother has been told she has six months to live.

dialogue.content: それは深刻なお悩みになりますね
dialogue.English: That must be a deeply serious concern.

dialogue.content: 私だけでは、色々と決断出来ない事もありますし、きょうだいの意見を聞きたいのですが、会話にならず切られます
dialogue.English: There are things I can’t decide on my own, and I want to hear my siblings’ opinions, but the conversation goes nowhere and they hang up.

dialogue.content: お辛いお気持ちを抱えての話し合いはたいへんですよね。Aさんはご自分のご意見をどのようにお伝えしているのですか
dialogue.English: It must be very hard to have these discussions while dealing with such painful feelings. How are you communicating your own opinions?

dialogue.content: 何も伝える間もなく、切られてしまうので聞いては貰えてません
dialogue.English: They hang up before I can say anything, so they don’t hear me out.

dialogue.content: 聞いても貰えない。。。それは行き場がなくなりますよね
dialogue.English: They won't even listen... That must make you feel like you have nowhere to turn.

dialogue.content: Aさんはご兄弟がそのようになってしまう事に何かお心当たりはありますか
dialogue.English: Do you have any idea why your siblings might be acting that way?

dialogue.content: 別に私の意見は良いのですが、話し合いが出来ないと全ての事を私が決断しなくてはならないので、私が決めて良いものなのか戸惑うし責任の重さに耐えられなくなってます
dialogue.English: It's not really about my own opinions, but if we can't discuss it, I have to decide everything myself. I'm at a loss as to whether it's okay for me to be the one deciding, and the weight of the responsibility is becoming unbearable.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I can understand that.

dialogue.content: 恐らく、母と姉、母と兄、母と私、母と妹の関係で同居の時は過ごしていたので横の絆がない気がします
dialogue.English: I think it's because when we lived together, our relationships were always one-on-one: mother and older sister, mother and older brother, mother and me, mother and younger sister. I feel like there's no bond between us siblings.

dialogue.content: ええ、でもAさんはご兄弟皆で決めて皆行きたいのですね
dialogue.English: I see, but you want to decide and move forward with all your siblings together, don't you?

dialogue.content: きょうだいの意見を尊重したいですし
dialogue.English: I want to respect my siblings’ opinions.

dialogue.content: ただ
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: 意見を言ってくれないのであれば、後から文句など言わないで欲しいと思います
dialogue.English: if they're not going to give their opinions, then I don't want them to complain about it later.

dialogue.content: ええ、それにお辛いお気持ちをお一人で抱えながらそのような決断までお一人では大変ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, and it must be so difficult to have to make those kinds of decisions all by yourself while carrying such painful feelings.

dialogue.content: はい、せめて見舞い位は来れないのか。と言う腹立たしさもあります
dialogue.English: Yes, and I also feel angry, thinking, "Can't they at least come to visit her?"

dialogue.content: お見舞いにもいらっしゃらないのですね。。
dialogue.English: So they don't come to visit, either...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お母さまとAさんとのご関係は今までも含めてどのような感じでしょう
dialogue.English: What has your relationship with your mother been like, up to now?

dialogue.content: 他のきょうだいも母と一対一の繋がりなので比べは出来ませんが、可愛がって貰ってるとは思います
dialogue.English: My other siblings also had one-on-one relationships with our mother, so I can't compare, but I do think she was fond of me.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: お母様とのご関係は良好なのですね？お母さまとはご病気のことはお話しされていますか
dialogue.English: So you have a good relationship with your mother? Do you talk with her about her illness?

dialogue.content: はい病気の事はお互い主治医の話しを一緒に聞いてはいますが、2人の時は敢えて話しません
dialogue.English: Yes, we both listen to the doctor together, but when it's just the two of us, we make a point not to talk about it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。そうなると、お一人で押しつぶされそうな気持ちになりますね
dialogue.English: I see... In that case, you must feel like you're about to be crushed under the weight of it all.

dialogue.content: お母さまからは他のご兄弟のことは何かおっしゃっていますか
dialogue.English: Does your mother say anything about your other siblings?

dialogue.content: 会いたいな。。。というような
dialogue.English: Like, maybe that she wants to see them...?

dialogue.content: 母の辛い時の表情や痛み出した時にさする事しか出来ないし…この辛さも本当はきょうだいと共有したいのです
dialogue.English: When my mother looks like she's in pain or when she starts hurting, all I can do is rub her back... I really want to share this pain with my siblings too.

dialogue.content: きょうだいの事は何も話題に出ません
dialogue.English: She doesn't bring up my siblings at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。。。お母さまからは
dialogue.English: I see... not from your mother.

dialogue.content: Aさんはお母さまにどのようにしてあげたいですか
dialogue.English: What would you like to do for your mother, A?

dialogue.content: なので、母の代弁としてもきょうだいに私が投げかけているのですが会話にならずな感じです
dialogue.English: So, I've been trying to talk to my siblings on my mother's behalf as well, but it doesn't lead to a conversation.

dialogue.content: Aさんはお優しい方なのですね。。。本当に
dialogue.English: You're a very kind person, A... truly.

dialogue.content: 母には1日も早く穏やかに旅だって貰いたいです私も精神的と体力に限界が来てますし、自分の家族の面倒もろくに見れてないので母にばかり時間をとられるのも苦痛です
dialogue.English: I want my mother to pass away peacefully, as soon as possible. I'm reaching my mental and physical limits, and I can't even properly care for my own family, so it's painful to have all my time taken up by my mother.

dialogue.content: 優しくないです母の看病から逃げたくてきょうだいと分担したいと言う思いもあります
dialogue.English: I'm not kind. I also want to escape from caring for my mother and share the burden with my siblings.

dialogue.content: それはお一人で全てを抱えてしまったら当然の思いだと思いますよ。十分に頑張っておられると感じます
dialogue.English: I think that's a perfectly natural way to feel when you're shouldering everything by yourself. I feel you are doing more than enough.

dialogue.content: では、少しお話しえお振り返ってみてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Well then, may we review our conversation a bit?

dialogue.content: ええ、長女でも長男でもない私が何で！と、母へときょうだいへとの怒りにもなってます
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm not the eldest daughter or the eldest son, so why me?! That's turning into anger towards my mother and my siblings.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: Aさんのお母さまはご病気で、余命を宣告されています
dialogue.English: Your mother is ill and has been given a limited prognosis.

dialogue.content: Aさんは4人兄弟の3番目ですが、お一人でお母さまの治療法をきめなくてはならず
dialogue.English: You are the third of four siblings, but you have to decide on your mother's treatment plan by yourself,

dialogue.content: ご兄弟は電話をして相談しようとしても取り合ってくれないのですね
dialogue.English: and your siblings won't engage with you when you call to discuss it.

dialogue.content: 治療法はもう無いです決めなきゃ行けないのは死後の事です
dialogue.English: There are no more treatment options. What needs to be decided are the matters after her death.

dialogue.content: ごめんなさい。亡くなった後のことですね
dialogue.English: I’m sorry. You mean matters after she passes.

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's alright.

dialogue.content: というと、葬儀のことなどになりますよね
dialogue.English: So, that would mean things like the funeral, correct?

dialogue.content: もうひとつ、Aさんのご家族にも相談されていますか
dialogue.English: One more thing—have you also consulted your own family?

dialogue.content: 葬儀だけでなく、母のマンションの事や1人残される妹を誰が引き取るか？1人暮らしをするか。等問題は山積みです
dialogue.English: It's not just the funeral. There's also the matter of her apartment, and who will take in our younger sister who will be left alone, or if she'll live by herself. The problems are piling up.

dialogue.content: はい、していますが長男、長女に任せて家の事もやれ。と怒られる事も度々です
dialogue.English: Yes, I have, but they often get angry and tell me to leave it to the eldest son and daughter and take care of things at home.

dialogue.content: それは大変なご負担ですね
dialogue.English: That's a heavy burden to bear.

dialogue.content: Aさんお一人に大変なご負担がかかっているのがよくわかります。大変ですよね
dialogue.English: I can see that an incredible burden is falling on you alone, A. That must be so difficult.

dialogue.content: ただ、唯一の救いが母の後輩でもあり私を可愛がってくれてる方が今私の1番の理解者ですですが、その方にもご家庭があるので甘えてばかりもいられず
dialogue.English: However, my only saving grace is that one of my mother’s former colleagues, who is also very fond of me, is my biggest supporter right now. But she has a family of her own, so I can’t always lean on her.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: でも、その方にはご自身の状況やお気持ちをお伝え出来ているのですか
dialogue.English: But are you able to share your situation and feelings with that person?

dialogue.content: きょうだいへの電話もしてくれてもいるのですが、きょうだいで話し合うから。と切られてしまったようです
dialogue.English: She even tried calling my siblings for me, but it seems they told her, "We'll discuss it amongst ourselves," and hung up.

dialogue.content: それはがっかりしてしまいますね
dialogue.English: That must be so disappointing.

dialogue.content: 申し訳なくも感じてしまいますね
dialogue.English: You must feel apologetic towards her as well.

dialogue.content: はい、聞いて貰えは出来てますが、やはり肝心な事は身内では無いので出来る範囲、出来ない範囲ありますから
dialogue.English: Yes, she does listen to me, but since she's not family, there are limits to what she can and can't do when it comes to the important matters.

dialogue.content: ええ、そうだと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that’s true.

dialogue.content: Aさんは、今お家の事も犠牲にしてまで、ご兄弟の中でお一人でよく頑張っていらっしゃるとかんじます。
dialogue.English: I feel that you are trying so hard, A, doing this all by yourself among your siblings, even at the expense of your own home life.

dialogue.content: （だいぶ時間が過ぎてしまったので終了にいたしますか？）
dialogue.English: (It seems we've gone quite a bit over time, shall we wrap up?)

dialogue.content: はい、最後まで出来なくて申し訳ないです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm sorry we couldn't finish.

dialogue.content: 長い時間、オーバーしてまでお付き合い下さりありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for staying with me for so long, even going over time.

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for your time. I appreciate it.

dialogue.content: 今日はありがとうございました。終了しますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today. We'll end the session here.
